# Getting Started

> Jupyter Notebook を唯一のソースとしてコード・テスト・ドキュメントを同時管理できる Python ライブラリ開発フレームワーク。開発者がノートブック上で記述した内容を自動的に Python モジュール・テスト・Quarto ドキュメントサイトへ変換し、ノートブック駆動開発（NDD）を実現する。

## Guide

- [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): In the interest of fostering an open and welcoming environment, we as contributors and maintainers pledge to make participation in our project and our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.
- [An Example Markdown Post](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/tests/2020-01-14-test-markdown-post.md): A minimal example of using markdown with fastpages.
- [Essential Work-From-Home Advice: Cheap and Easy Ergonomic Setups](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/tests/2022-09-06-homeschooling.md): Lorem ipsum
- [Todo](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/TODO.md): - show_doc changes: - support #default_cls_lvl - pick header level for functions/methods - implement stuff from nbdev export2html, e.g.(?): - remove_w…
- [config](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/01_config.ipynb): Configuring nbdev and bootstrapping notebook export
- [maker](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/02_maker.ipynb): Create one or more modules from selected notebook cells
- [process](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/03_process.ipynb): A notebook processor
- [export](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/04_export.ipynb): Exporting a notebook to a library
- [doclinks](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/05_doclinks.ipynb): Generating a documentation index from a module
- [sync](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/06_sync.ipynb): Propagate small changes in the library back to notebooks
- [merge](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/07_merge.ipynb): Fix merge conflicts in jupyter notebooks
- [showdoc](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/08_showdoc.ipynb): Display symbol documentation in notebook and website
- [frontmatter](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/09_frontmatter.ipynb): A YAML and formatted-markdown frontmatter processor
- [processors](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/10_processors.ipynb): Some processors for NBProcessor
- [clean](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/11_clean.ipynb): Strip superfluous metadata from notebooks
- [test](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/12_test.ipynb): Run unit tests on notebooks in parallel
- [cli](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/13_cli.ipynb): CLI commands
- [quarto](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/14_quarto.ipynb): Install and interact with Quarto from nbdev
- [qmd](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/15_qmd.ipynb): Basic qmd generation helpers (experimental)
- [migrate](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/16_migrate.ipynb): Utilities for migrating to nbdev
- [serve](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/17_serve.ipynb): A parallel ipynb processor (experimental)
- [diff](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/api/19_diff.ipynb): Get ipynb diffs by cell
- [Configuration](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/explanations/config.ipynb): The nbdev configuration file
- [Directives](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/explanations/directives.ipynb): A cheat sheet of directives available in nbdev.
- [Docs Website](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/explanations/docs.ipynb): How nbdev renders a documentation website for your project.
- [Why nbdev](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/explanations/why_nbdev.ipynb): Why we develop software with nbdev
- [Getting Started](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/getting_started.ipynb): Create delightful software with Jupyter Notebooks
- [Notebook Best Practices](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/best_practices.ipynb): How to write great nbdev notebooks
- [Blogging](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/blogging.ipynb): Creating a blog with notebooks
- [Documentation Only Sites](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/docs_only.ipynb): How to create nbdev powered docs without a library!
- [Writing nbdev plugins](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/extensions.ipynb): How to customize nbdev processors to do what you want
- [Git-Friendly Jupyter](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/git_friendly_jupyter.ipynb): How to use nbdev hooks for git-friendly Jupyter notebooks
- [nbdev1 Migration](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/migrating.ipynb): How to change your nbdev1 repo to work with nbdev2
- [Modular nbdev](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/modular_nbdev.ipynb): How to use nbdev's various tools separately
- [Pre-Commit Hooks](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/pre_commit.ipynb): How to use nbdev's git pre-commit hooks
- [End-To-End Walkthrough](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/tutorial.ipynb): A step-by-step guide to using nbdev
- [Test Module some.thing](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/tests/00_some.thing.ipynb): Test module some.thing
- [A Title](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/tests/01_everything.ipynb): A description
- [Fastpages Notebook Blog Post](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/tests/2020-02-20-test.ipynb): A tutorial of fastpages for Jupyter notebooks.
- ["fastcore: An Underrated Python Library"](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/tests/2020-09-01-fastcore.ipynb): A unique python library that extends the python programming language and provides utilities that enhance productivity.
- [Apl](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/tests/APL.ipynb)
